claims: Matt Fitzpatrick won the 2026 RBC Heritage.
Matt Fitzpatrick took home $3.6 million from the 2026 RBC Heritage.
The 2026 RBC Heritage had a total signature event purse of $20 million.
Matt Fitzpatrick defeated Scottie Scheffler in a playoff.
Scottie Scheffler earned $2.16 million for second place.
The top three finishers all secured over $1 million.
Si Woo Kim took third place.
Si Woo Kim earned $1.36 million for third place.
